programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: S1E1 El Nino
programme.desc: Chasing El Niño follows Chris Benchetler on an epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the vast slopes of British Columbia. Joined by longtime friends Bryan Fox, Scotty Smith, and Canadian pro skier Nick McNutt, Chris explores previously inaccessible terrain, searches for perfect powder, and faces challenging weather conditions. Along the way, the crew embraces the joy of skiing, building creative jumps at their campsite and making the most of every moment on the mountain. This episode captures the thrill of exploration, friendship, and the relentless pursuit of epic lines.

programme.title: S1E2 El Nino

This time, X Games gold medalist Jossi Wells joins him for "The Sierra Trifecta," tackling skiing, climbing, and biking all in a single day. Chris and his crew hike 6,000 vertical feet through rugged rock fields to chase the last snow of the season in the Sierras, pushing their limits and capturing every thrilling moment.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.
